title: Louisville volleyball sweeps Notre Dame in ACC home opener
text:
← Back to the wire
Sports
Louisville volleyball sweeps Notre Dame in ACC home opener
The University of Louisville women's volleyball team defeated Notre Dame in straight sets during their ACC home opener on Sep. 30. Key performances came from Chloe Meester and setter Nayelis Cabello as the Cardinals improved their conference record.
The University of Louisville women's volleyball team swept Notre Dame in three sets (25-16, 25-18, 25-18) at L&N Federal Credit Union Arena on Sep. 30.
Louisville, ranked No. 4 nationally, improved its record to 13-2 overall and 3-0 in the Atlantic Coast Conference with the win. The Cardinals hit .353 as a team and recorded seven aces while holding Notre Dame to a .134 hitting percentage. Defensively, Louisville tallied 37 digs and posted 11 blocks.
Dan & Maria Durbin Head Coach Dan Meske said, "Great win against Notre Dame, our travel partner. We've gone five [sets] with them a lot, had some battles, and I can't remember a time we handled them as well as we did tonight. We hit .350, we held them to .130, it was nice to see double-digit blocks again, and obviously, Chloe Meester really went off. It was just top-to-bottom a really good performance."
Outside hitter Chloe Meester led Louisville's offense by hitting .579 with 13 kills and four aces. This marked her tenth match this season with double-digit kills and her third hitting over .500. Outside hitter Chloe Chicoine added twelve kills on a .333 clip for her fourteenth match this year reaching double-digit kills.
Setter Nayelis Cabello contributed by guiding the offense with 32 assists while also recording ten digs and four blocks on defense.
Louisville will next face Notre Dame again on Saturday in South Bend, Indiana.
